primary_organization.compatibility: L1-L6 remain reporting profiles; their classifier and frozen native verdicts are unchanged.

atomic.title: 原子操作
atomic.boundary: One registered active skill from a qualified ready state.

subprotocol.title: 实验单元
subprotocol.boundary: A reusable experimental output state; core non-looping compositions commonly use 2-5 skills.

complete_protocol.title: 完整实验
complete_protocol.boundary: Named sample-to-result scope including preparation, measurement, attributable result, record and safe shutdown.

validity_window.title: 样品或操作是否仍在有效时窗

process_treatment.title: 所需过程处理是否已经交付

state_confirmation.title: 可测状态是否发生并被正确确认

time_resolved_measurement.title: 是否正确测量了过程的时间演化

coordination.title: 多个有效过程能否协调执行

endpoint_quantitation.title: 滴定与端点定量
endpoint_quantitation.subprotocol: Incremental delivery, mixing, candidate confirmation and conditional continuation.
endpoint_quantitation.complete_output: Measured-volume-based concentration or content with attributable initial and final readings.
endpoint_quantitation.distinguishing_pair: Same current volume with different observed initial volumes, or transient versus persistent endpoint histories.

development_quantitation.title: 显色与定量读数
development_quantitation.subprotocol: Source-anchored development, blank zero and valid sample acquisition.
development_quantitation.complete_output: Sample-specific concentrations, standard check and valid identity/timer chain.
development_quantitation.distinguishing_pair: Same current observation/clock after different publicly observed per-sample start histories.

thermal_gravimetry.title: 热处理与质量分析
thermal_gravimetry.subprotocol: Treatment, desiccator cooling, weighing, adjacent-cycle comparison and conditional repetition.
thermal_gravimetry.complete_output: A selected method's loss-on-drying or gravimetric result and complete mass history.
thermal_gravimetry.distinguishing_pair: Same current mass and different publicly measured previous-cycle masses.
thermal_gravimetry.source_boundary: Oven moisture determination and sulfate precipitation/filtration/ashing are different protocols; their constants cannot be mixed.
blockers: fully specified method and convergence criterion

reaction_kinetics.title: 反应动力学测量
reaction_kinetics.subprotocol: Initiation, measured transfer/acquisition delay and timestamped observation sequence.
reaction_kinetics.complete_output: An attributable time series and estimated kinetic quantity with model/uncertainty checks.
reaction_kinetics.distinguishing_pair: Similar final signals but different earlier trajectories and measured acquisition histories.

separation_purification.title: 分离与纯化
separation_purification.subprotocol: Observed phase or nucleation transition with conditional continuation.
separation_purification.complete_output: Recovery and independently assessed composition or purity.
separation_purification.distinguishing_pair: Similar elapsed times with different observed separation or nucleation states.
blockers: validated phase filtration or crystallization dynamics

study_contract.matched_unit: Same sampled protocol instance and predeclared perturbation stream; batch is the independent unit when samples are coupled.
study_contract.memory_proof: Same current allowed observation and different correct decisions after different previously observable histories.

operation_unit.definition: One registered laboratory operation with declared entry state and an independently measured termination condition; internal IK phases are not extra operations.
operation_unit.repetition: Repeated physical operations contribute their actual executed count; a loop may not be renamed as one atomic skill.
operation_unit.composition_horizon: Core local combinations use 2-5 operations; 6-10 is a reported extension, not an automatic promotion to a complete experiment.

L1.title: 原子操作
L1.goal: One physical or active measurement operation from an admitted ready state.

L2.title: 带时间要求的原子操作
L2.goal: Same atomic operation with a declared completion, duration, response or rate contract.

L3.title: 局部组合操作
L3.goal: Compose 2-5 semantic operations, with a separately reported 6-10-operation extension.

L4.title: 带过程时序或反应逻辑的组合操作
L4.goal: Couple a local combination to measured process conditions and/or explicit temporal relations.

L5.title: 完整实验协议
L5.goal: Complete preparation, execution, measurement, recording and safe shutdown within a source-defined experimental scope.

L6.title: 时间敏感的完整实验协议
L6.goal: Complete the same declared experimental scope while satisfying source-conditioned temporal and process contracts.

duration.title: 持续或保持时长
duration.semantics: D_min <= t_stop - t_start <= D_max; qualifying process state must hold throughout when specified
duration.existing_checker: TDuration; temperature/state qualification needs process instrumentation

event_response.title: 状态触发后的响应窗口

rate.title: 速率或变化率
rate.semantics: r_min <= dx/dt <= r_max over the measured active interval

relative_interval.title: 操作先后与间隔
relative_interval.semantics: a <= t_B - t_A <= b, with event identities and operation scope fixed
relative_interval.existing_checker: TDuration gap plus explicit order guard

synchronization.title: 并行同步与共享窗口
synchronization.semantics: Coupled per-sample intervals, cross-sample acquisition span and resource exclusion.
synchronization.existing_checker: design_only; no generic native synchronization referee

cumulative_exposure.title: 累计过程暴露或剂量
cumulative_exposure.semantics: Q = integral f(state(t)) dt; f and units must be protocol-specific
cumulative_exposure.existing_checker: existing F0 thermal/dose surrogate only; not native chemistry calibration

persistence.title: 连续稳定判据
persistence.semantics: A predicate must remain true continuously for D; a false interval resets the dwell clock.
persistence.existing_checker: TEvent persistence; state predicates require instrumentation

periodic_sampling.title: 周期采样
periodic_sampling.semantics: Each required sample lies in its own declared window; missing samples cannot be hidden by an average rate.
periodic_sampling.existing_checker: design_only; TRate sampling coverage is not a complete periodic-acquisition referee

open_cabinet.note: Open is one semantic operation; approach and release are internal phases.

press.note: T4-v2 timed press from the ready pose.

pick_place.note: Pick then place; six archive stages are not six operations.

bottle_balance.note: Pick-place-repick-return; eight archived stages are not a complete chemical experiment.

delayed_cue_memory.note: Memory-conditioned pick-place; retention is not an extra manipulation.

pour.note: Pick-pour-place with a duration constraint; no calibrated chemical reaction.

endpoint_stop.note: Three to seven dose-button presses plus finish; the 6-8 range is a local-composition extension.

titration_endpoint_confirmation.note: Coarse/fine delivery, transient versus persistent tint with identical instantaneous colour, 30 s persistence before declaration, overshoot and analytical error from delivered volume.

robot_evidence.verifier: measured-v1 titration_verifier (contact-derived doses, referee, receiver contrast, safety)

development_read_window.note: Per-sample method-timer and physical-age anchors, blank zero before reads, one shared photometer, random public arrival order; late reads stay invalid even when numerically close.

robot_evidence.ablation_scope: Declared read-on-load controller only; not a bound on all fixed-wait policies.
robot_evidence.verifier: measured-v1 development_verifier (contact-derived keys, vial poses, sample referee and safety)
robot_evidence.recording_acceptance: All 20 expert and 10 ablation trajectories replayed with complete video decode; NAS copy size-checked.

qualification_boundary.fixed_strategy_35_percent_gate: applies only to the earlier randomized diagnostic controls; not every source-defined chemical method
qualification_boundary.prescribed_fixed_wait: may be the correct strategy for a declared standard method
